prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 01-design-md.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: packages/gauntlet-ui/DESIGN.md is the base system every gauntlet inherits: layout, spacing rhythm, type scale *structure*, motion vocabulary, the celebration moments, and the component inventory.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 01-design-md.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: apps/<gauntlet>/brand.md overrides only the brand layer (see 02).

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 01-design-md.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Reference both from CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md under a "UI & Design System" heading so discovery doesn't depend on each agent's own conventions.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 01-design-md.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: The prose explains decisions; it does not restate the tokens. "Body text is 17px because answers are read right after speaking, on a phone, often while stressed" helps an agent. "Body is 17px" alone does not.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 01-design-md.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: One source of truth. Tokens in the YAML are generated into CSS and TS (03). Never hand-edit the generated files.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 01-design-md.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: A stale file is worse than none. CI checks that the YAML tokens match the generated @theme output (07).

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 01-design-md.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Never copy another company's DESIGN.md. The 67k-star awesome-design-md collection is fine for studying structure. Copying its tokens gives you a knockoff (Adam Wathan's criticism).

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 01-design-md.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: DESIGN.md covers tokens, not behavior. Component behavior (states, focus, loading) comes from the component registry and its types, not from this file.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 02-brand-md.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Audience + worst day. Who is in the room, and what is at stake?

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 02-brand-md.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Three adjectives + three anti-adjectives. Every later taste decision is checked against these.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 02-brand-md.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Aesthetic family, named explicitly, e.g. "editorial broadsheet", "flight-deck instrument", "field notebook", "arcade boss fight". Unnamed direction drifts to the generic default.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 02-brand-md.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Two or three references (real products or cultural sources), each with the specific thing being borrowed.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 02-brand-md.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: One signature element, the thing people will remember (e.g. the Climb mountain, a verdict stamp, a pressure gauge).

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 02-brand-md.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: The brand layer changes only brand values. A brand can't change the spacing rhythm, verdict colors, component behavior or the moment catalog. That boundary is what keeps "different genre, same game" true.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 02-brand-md.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Seed, don't hand-pick. One brand color goes in; the generator produces the 12 steps plus dark mode with contrast guaranteed (03). Hand-picked palettes are where contrast failures and muddy dark modes come from.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 02-brand-md.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Contrast is validated at build time, via design.md lint and the generator. It is never checked by eye.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 03-tokens-and-typescript.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Why OKLCH: it is perceptually uniform, so steps look evenly spaced. HSL scales drift purple in the light steps and go muddy in the dark ones.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 03-tokens-and-typescript.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: The 12 steps have fixed roles (Radix model): 1–2 app and subtle backgrounds; 3–5 component backgrounds and states; 6–8 borders; 9 is the solid brand color (highest chroma); 10 is hover; 11 low-contrast text; 12 high-contrast text.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 03-tokens-and-typescript.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Generate, don't pick. Candidate tools are oklch-palette (seed → 12 steps, CSS vars and a Tailwind preset) and OKChroma (contrast built into the math, APCA check). Evaluate both at build time.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 03-tokens-and-typescript.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Keep grays and status colors from a proven set (Radix Colors), tinted toward the brand hue, and generate only the brand scale. Radix itself recommends this split.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 03-tokens-and-typescript.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Light and dark come from the same generator run, not a hand-made second palette.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 03-tokens-and-typescript.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Use @theme for tokens that should become utilities, and :root for variables that shouldn't.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 03-tokens-and-typescript.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: For runtime theme switching, keep raw values in :root / .dark and map them through @theme. Before relying on @theme inline, test the dark-mode switch; sources disagree on whether it survives runtime switching.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 03-tokens-and-typescript.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Add @custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *)); so the dark: variant follows the class.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 03-tokens-and-typescript.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Class names must be complete literal strings. Never build one like  bg-${color} . Conditional classes go through variants or cn().

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 03-tokens-and-typescript.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Motion tokens (durations, springs) also live in the token layer, so CSS and Motion read the same values (05).

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 03-tokens-and-typescript.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Typed skin. GauntletSkin (item 5 in ARCHITECTURE §4) is a typed object that the brand.md build step generates and validates. A missing tagline or an unknown motion temperament is a type error, not a runtime surprise.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 03-tokens-and-typescript.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Typed variants. Use tailwind-variants for multi-slot components (RunView, ReportView, Verdict, and the Worst Day HUD). It has slots, compound variants and built-in merging, and it infers VariantProps types. Use CVA only for trivial single-element components, or skip it and stay on one library.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 03-tokens-and-typescript.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: v4 caveat: tailwind-variants' responsive variants were removed. Use plain responsive prefixes inside the variant strings.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 03-tokens-and-typescript.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Domain-typed props, not style props. Components take band: 'absent' | 'gestured' | 'landed' | 'nailed', not color="green". The engine's vocabulary *is* the design API, which ties visual meaning to scoring meaning.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 03-tokens-and-typescript.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Only token-backed classes appear in variant files. If text-gray-500 shows up, the right token is missing or wasn't used. Lint catches both (07).

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 04-component-systems.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: We own the source: components are copied into the repo, not hidden in node_modules.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 04-component-systems.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Accessibility comes from Base UI.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 04-component-systems.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Agents already know the conventions, and shadcn ships agent skills for them.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 04-component-systems.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Our own registry. packages/gauntlet-ui publishes a registry.json with a registry:style using "extends": "none" (fully independent), plus cssVars in theme / light / dark scopes. Each gauntlet app installs components from *our* registry, not upstream.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 04-component-systems.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Pick a starting style per brand shape. shape: sharp → Lyra (boxy, pairs with mono), soft → Maia, compact → Mira. It's only a starting point, since our tokens override it.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 04-component-systems.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Game components beyond shadcn's set live in the same registry: Verdict, BeatTrack, RecordButton, LatencyStage, ClimbMountain, WorstDayHUD, Celebration. These are what make it a game rather than a dashboard.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 04-component-systems.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Known trap: switching or re-applying a shadcn preset rewrites component classes and wipes custom variants. Set the preset once at init, then manage everything through our registry and tokens, never with preset apply.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 04-component-systems.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Upstream updates come in through shadcn add --diff and are reviewed, never blindly overwritten.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 04-component-systems.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: That Base UI is the shadcn default since July 2026 (one source; check the changelog).

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 04-component-systems.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: The exact list of 8 styles (one third-party source).

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 04-component-systems.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Whether the Tailwind Plus licenses we might already hold get updates.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 05-motion-and-celebration.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Durations: instant (≈100ms), fast (≈150ms), base (≈250ms), slow (≈400ms), and moment for choreographed sequences.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 05-motion-and-celebration.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Springs: the brand's motion-temperament (crisp / bouncy / weighty) picks a { visualDuration, bounce } preset. The same values feed MotionConfig, AnimateView and the CSS easings.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 05-motion-and-celebration.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Stagger: one shared value for list and evidence reveals.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 05-motion-and-celebration.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Choreograph; don't scatter. One orchestrated sequence per moment, using staggered reveals, a clear order, and a clear final rest state.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 05-motion-and-celebration.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Motion carries meaning. Direction and weight encode the outcome: success rises and settles, a miss holds and redirects. Never play a generic bounce on everything.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 05-motion-and-celebration.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Reduced motion is required. Set <MotionConfig reducedMotion="user"> explicitly at the root; don't assume it's the default. Add a @media (prefers-reduced-motion) block for View Transitions, since React won't do that for you. Replace large transforms with opacity changes. Anything that loops or autoplays needs a pause control (WCAG 2.2.2).

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 05-motion-and-celebration.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Performance: pause offscreen Rive files, cache reused .riv files, and scope view transitions tightly (snapshots are costly on low-end phones).

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 05-motion-and-celebration.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Screenshot tests freeze motion so baselines are deterministic (07).

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Inter, Roboto, Arial, Open Sans, Lato, system-ui as the *display* face

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Space Grotesk (the model's fallback once Inter is banned)

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: A single font family used for everything

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Timid scale steps (14/16/18). Use real contrast between sizes

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: A purple or blue gradient on white or near-black

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: The 2026 "anti-slop" tell: a warm cream background + a serif display face (Instrument Serif, Fraunces) + a sage or forest-green accent. It's what you get by swapping one default for another

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Colors spread evenly with no dominant one

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Pure #000 / #fff surfaces with untinted grays

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Gradient text as decoration

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: A centered hero, then three feature cards, then a CTA band

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Every section in the same rounded card with the same shadow

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Uniform spacing everywhere, with no rhythm and no tension

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Pill badges and "✨ New" chips as decoration

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Glassmorphism as the default surface

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Emoji used as icons

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Generic stock illustrations or blob backgrounds

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Mixed icon sets, or icons used where a word would read better

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Fade-up on every element as it scrolls in

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Hover-scale on every card

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Spinners where a latency choreography belongs (05)

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: "Unlock your potential", "Supercharge", "Seamless", "Elevate", "Revolutionize"

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Generic empty states ("Nothing here yet!"). Write each one in the brand voice

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: A named aesthetic family and three adjectives (02).

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: A distinctive display face paired with a refined body face. Pick with intent, and look past the usual places: editorial serifs, grotesques with character, mono for data.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: One dominant color with sharp accents. For inspiration, look at IDE themes, print, sport, signage, and cultural aesthetics, not other SaaS sites.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Backgrounds with atmosphere: texture, grain, a tinted ground, or a structural grid. Never a flat default gray.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: One signature element per brand that nobody else has.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Hierarchy through contrast. Size, weight and space do the work before color does.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Data looks like instruments. Scores, beats and the mountain are designed visualizations, not stat cards.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Could this screen be a different product's with the logo swapped? If yes, it's slop.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Does it match the three adjectives, and avoid the three anti-adjectives?

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: What is the one thing a user remembers from this screen?

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 06-anti-slop.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Is the most important thing visually the most important?

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 07-guardrails-and-verification.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Escape hatch with a reason. An exception requires a stated reason (e.g. a designSystemException="…" prop or a lint-disable with a justification) so it stays visible.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 07-guardrails-and-verification.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Ratchet baseline. When adopting on existing code, record the current violation count; it can only go down.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 07-guardrails-and-verification.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Monorepo: set settings["better-tailwindcss"].cwd per app. Plugins switch off silently when they can't resolve Tailwind, so CI must assert that the plugin is active.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 07-guardrails-and-verification.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Playwright MCP gives Claude a real browser (claude mcp add playwright npx '@playwright/mcp@latest').

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 07-guardrails-and-verification.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Define "verified" explicitly. Otherwise an agent with a screenshot tool will still declare a broken page done. Our definition: the screenshot is checked at 375px and 1440px, in light and dark, with every celebration moment shown in its final state, and passes the 06 gut check.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 07-guardrails-and-verification.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Measure, don't eyeball. Use Playwright evaluate to check computed font family, size and color against the tokens.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 07-guardrails-and-verification.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Playwright toHaveScreenshot for each screen × brand × theme × width.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 07-guardrails-and-verification.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Generate baselines in the same container image CI uses. Commit them, and never update one without looking at the diff.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 07-guardrails-and-verification.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Keep them deterministic: mask dynamic content, freeze animations (reduced-motion mode plus the Motion test config), and use fixed fonts. Fix flakiness at the source; never raise the tolerance.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 07-guardrails-and-verification.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Anti-slop audit against 06.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 07-guardrails-and-verification.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Celebration audit: does each moment in the 05 catalog fire on the right event, and does it degrade cleanly under reduced motion?

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 08-claude-workflow.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Brand brief interview: the five questions in 02. No code.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 08-claude-workflow.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Write brand.md. The user approves it.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 08-claude-workflow.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Generate tokens: OKLCH scales, @theme CSS, TS skin types. Run the contrast lint.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 08-claude-workflow.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Specimen page first: type, color steps, verdict bands, every component variant, and each moment in its final state, on one page. The user approves the *look* here, before any real screens exist. This is the cheapest place to fix taste.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 08-claude-workflow.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Build screens from registry components only. Missing component → add it to the registry with variants, never a one-off.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 08-claude-workflow.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Self-verify: lint green, Playwright screenshots at 375/1440 × light/dark, and computed styles match the tokens.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 08-claude-workflow.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: /design-review, including the anti-slop and celebration audits.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 08-claude-workflow.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Commit baselines, and the result is Rev1.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 08-claude-workflow.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Name the direction out loud before writing UI (aesthetic family + adjectives). If it can't be named, stop and ask.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 08-claude-workflow.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Iterate on the output; don't re-prompt from scratch. Adjust tokens and components from the screenshot, as the Claude Design "Tweaks" pattern does.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 08-claude-workflow.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Use Context7 for library APIs. Tailwind v4, shadcn CLI v4, Base UI, Motion and View Transitions have all changed in 2025–26, so training memory is out of date.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 08-claude-workflow.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: No speculative components. Build only what a screen needs, but always as a registry item with typed variants.

prescriptions.group_origin_note: Compiled guidance · 08-claude-workflow.md · 25 Sep 2026
prescriptions.text: Claude's own design tools (/design artboards, Claude Design) are good for exploring a brand in steps 1–4, and their output goes back into brand.md tokens.
